title: React to Agents (appearance.agentGlow, off by default): a terminal agent works (a faint wash in its machine's color), asks for permission (a soft glow at the window's edges), then stops (calm). Record it with: cmux-ci capture SHA --state scripts/cmux-next/media/states/agent-glow.json --video --pr N

steps.title: Calm: no agent works or waits
A Claude agent in this terminal starts a turn
cmux: cmux agent hook emit --source claude --event UserPromptSubmit --payload-json '{"session_id":"glow-capture"}'; clear

steps.title: It asks for permission
cmux: cmux agent hook emit --source claude --event PermissionRequest --payload-json '{"session_id":"glow-capture","tool_name":"Bash"}'; clear

steps.title: Its turn ends
cmux: cmux agent hook emit --source claude --event Stop --payload-json '{"session_id":"glow-capture"}'; clear
